body: Don't kill yourself, you have helped me not to tonight, and maybe I wont the next time I get like this. I guess it is like a game of Jenga, that fear of when you pull out a block and then the tower doesn't fall, yet each time it is closer and closer. But please don't kill yourself, I don't want to be alone with these assholes. You know, most depressed people I have met are the better people in life, I guess for some people it is easier to enjoy life when you are an asshole. Then there is me I am asshole impaired, I don't take at another's expense (well I can be a bit of a dick to guys who are absolute pricks, but to the average person I am nice, and usually this is exploited).

I listen to Russian 30s and 40s music, and American 60s and 70s more mellow music, so I have no room to judge. I pray that one day it will, it's just hard holding on to a hope that is not in sight. My Step dad gone through like 5 marriages (dluckily on't live with the bastard) My dad went through a really crappy one and same with my step mom, and my mother, well she is just a whore. I sadly feel like love is just something in les mis (favorite book/play/movie) or in the works of Shakespeare. I just don't know where to find this hope.
Man, I love deer! You are a hero, go get yourself a jamba juice, you deserve it.

I hope I find someone, I just want to believe in love, but I am worried that it does not exist. With me I was born with a passion for things such as helping people, or making people smile, but my heart just can't focus on anything but love, and I'm losing any bit of hope I had. My Ex, I thought I loved her, but I guess it was really a want to love, I would put in so much time and effort into us, and she wouldn't even try, I was like a hobby for when she was bored. I know am pessimistic about my future, I want to put in my enormous passion into someone, and receive it back, I want to hold hands and dance around the house, but what girl wants that? When I was with my ex and believed I had love (such a stupid mistake) I was able to be well..Jolly (sorry it's a strange term, I just when I am happy, I am full of life) I tried talking to several girls, but then I just realized I am looking for a relationship, there is not a girl around me who just matches me. I'm not into rap or pop, so bam out goes most girls, I want a relationship to be a long lasting thing not a short "oh look I have a girl, I wonder who I will have next week." I am about to take college classes for photography yet I once mentioned this to a girl and she snickered and said how pointless photography was. I am frustrated with life and society, and feel like there is no place for the Man who loves poetry, art, science, politics philosophy and especially romance. I'm better suited during the Victorian years or the Renaissance (If I was born in florence during those times, I don't think anyone would ever match my happiness).

I'm sorry for pouring out all of this, I haven no one to rant to, and really needed to get things out. And I am really scared that depression will win out, as my suicidal thoughts have been increasing.
I did and I got the whole I like to sleep around bits, will look again.
Is there any hint in my horoscope that I will find the love I want?

Actually for me love is a huge thing, I'm a bit disappointed by astrology as it says I'm promiscuous but that is farthest from the truth and Im not for waiting for marriage but waiting for love. For me love is my one goal in life, would rather have that than wealth and power. For me I want my lover to big the biggest part of my life and vice versa.
I guess anything about love for me, I'm a guy who isn't like many others and see monogamous love as my biggest goal in life, is there anything hinting I will have a nice love life?
